notes.title: Update 1.6.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b](New)[/b] Now is possible to change the On/Off status for Advanced Conveyor belt.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] Marketplace projects with Teleports/bridges was corrupting the save data.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] Advanced conveyor belt was not outputting to some machines in some cases.
[*] [b](Improved)[/b] Disassembler now can also partially disassemble non boxed bundles.
[*] [b](Improved)[/b] Now is possible to modify multiple drone stations at the same time.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] Other minor bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] (New!) Conveyor belt Adv and S200 version is now available.
[*] (New!) S200 Delivery stations box stack increased to 20 items.
[*] (New!) Sales graph shows now the rank-rate.
[*] (Update) Challenge requirements and rewards have been increased.
[*] (Improved) Quality check machine now shows the last scanned items info.
[*] (Improved) Power and sales graphs can be now toggled.
[*] (Improved) Advanced hologram projector is now 3 times faster.
[*] (Improved) Factory loading is now 5 times faster.
[*] (Improved) Drone delivery service request.
[*] (Fixed) Different forklift speeds was affecting production rate.
[*] (Fixed) On some devices was not possible to complete the tutorial.
[*] (Fixed) Sometimes the conveyor belt anim would get stuck.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b](New!)[/b] A new 'Graphics Card' product is now available for production and sale, which includes 16 new items.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/afcc05038df67cd26ad25d9401379c44c1ebc20d.png[/img]

[*] [b](New!)[/b] An advanced hologram projector is now available that allows you to tape the floor with a special tape and project the name of the area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/d9201965f4d0c37bd6f36f816b051bcb88e5d3a7.png[/img]

[*] [b](New!)[/b] It is now possible to perform a multiple selection without a dummy block by holding down the ctrl key and the left mouse button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/cbd2f776a9fc7d0ebb8a2391aefc47985b5c55e3.png[/img]

[*] [b](New!)[/b] It is now possible to place more blocks than are available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/7735df6b2bad0e4fc212d2ae7965823e03e21fec.png[/img]

[*] [b](New!)[/b] New explorer interface for Generator and Conveyor Arm machines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566049/9e0dd8f8b42c3f7ea3fa054a465f384600530ae0.png[/img]

[*] [b](New!)[/b] Automatic purchase mode is now available. Select a blueprint as favourite and activate auto mode.
[*] [b](New!)[/b] It is now possible to enter a customised amount in the dialogue box during purchase.
[*] [b](New!)[/b] Disassembly machines now allow their behaviour with bundled products to be configured.
[*] [b](New!)[/b] Quality check machines now allow you to change the threshold.
[*] [b](Improved)[/b] Ambient occlusion has been improved over long distances.
[*] [b](Improved)[/b] Visual controls has been improved.
[*] [b](Improved)[/b] Market project limit is now 5000 instead of 1000.
[*] [b](Improved)[/b] The overall gaming experience has been improved.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] The QC rejection of some bundled products was too high.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] After a factory restart with 'Generators OFF/ON' set to off, the tutorial could not be completed.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] The conveyor bridge and conveyor teleport sometimes became clogged.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] An error appeared when trying to delete some machines and a container together.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] Copy/move mode moved incorrectly when the floating UI was too close to the edge of the screen.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] When destroying elements from a Disassembler machine, the machine would get stuck.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] When destroying items from a Drone Station machine, the machine would get stuck.
[*] [b](Fixed)[/b] Other minor bugs were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.6.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] (New!) FPS Limiter is now available under settings > advanced settings > Target framerate
[*] (New!) Marketplace projects now can store up to 20 projects and 1000 blocks per project.
[*] (Fixed) Placing conveyor teleports between other conveyor teleports was not allowed.
[*] (Fixed) Now the game keeps running in background.
[*] (Fixed) Some 3d models had wrong uv mapping.
[*] (Fixed) Containers output was slow down after reaching 5 or less items.
[*] (Improved) Performance have been improved.
[*] (Improved) User experience has been improved.
[/list]
